## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

Link the related issue or proposal, when applicable.

## Verification

List checks actually run and any platform limitations.

- [ ] I reviewed my diff and ran the checks relevant to this change.
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog reflect any changed behavior.
- [ ] Manifest, saved-run, or agent-interface compatibility is preserved or explained.
- [ ] No workspace state, credentials, private application data, or generated runtime outputs are included.

## Evidence

For UI or runner changes, attach screenshots or run evidence from the bundled example. Review artifacts for application data before sharing.
